name: Altru Health System Junior Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in the health system and see health jobs up close. You get an orientation and on-the-job experience.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.

name: Iowa 4-H Youth Conference
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Spend three days on the Iowa State campus. You go to workshops, tours and evening events, build leadership skills and explore careers. You stay in a residence hall.
deadline_text: The 2026 conference was June 23 to 25. Registration ran from April 1 to June 1, 2026. Dates for 2027 are not posted. Expect a spring sign up again.

name: Iowa State RISE with WiSE Summer Experience
org: Program for Women in Science and Engineering, Iowa State University
what_you_do: A one week stay on the Iowa State campus. Pick one of two hands-on STEM tracks, Engineering or Life Sciences, taught by faculty, staff and students. You also get a taste of college life.
deadline_text: Applications open in January, per the page. The page gives no year and no closing date. It does not say if the $450 price applies to 2027.

name: STEM Drone Summer Camp
what_you_do: Build a drone that works. Learn to solder. Learn the FAA safety rules. Fly drones with an adult watching. Then study the data from the air with GIS tools.
deadline_text: The page lists dates but no year and no deadline. Spots are limited.

name: WIOA Youth Program (Billings area)
org: District VII HRDC with the Montana Department of Labor and Industry
what_you_do: Get help to finish school and get ready for work. You can get tutoring. You can get paid or unpaid work. You can get job training, a mentor and help with college.
deadline_text: No application dates stated on the state program page.

name: LINKS (Leadership Institute for Nature, Kids and Stewardship)
what_you_do: Be a trained mentor for 3rd to 6th graders in an after-school program. You canoe, build forts, play games and explore the outdoors with them.
deadline_text: Spring 2026 applications were due March 26, 2026. The page says there are fall and spring sessions. Next dates are not posted.

name: Movin' On
org: Montana Center on Inclusive Education, MSU Billings
what_you_do: Visit MSU Billings, City College and Rocky Mountain College. Get a mentor who is a college student with a disability. There is also a four day summer camp in the dorms.
deadline_text: The page says Summer Camp 2027 information is coming soon. No dates or deadline are posted.

name: TRIO Upward Bound
what_you_do: Meet with an advisor during the school year and spend six summer weeks living on campus. You take enrichment classes and go on field trips. It prepares you for college.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: Summer jobs at Oasis WaterPark
what_you_do: Work summer jobs at a water park: lifeguard, swim instructor, concessions, or guest services. Most jobs start at age 15.
deadline_text: The program page says Oasis is no longer taking applications for Summer 2026. Next summer's dates are not posted.

name: Youth Volunteer Corps
what_you_do: Sign up for team service projects posted online and log your volunteer hours. The city says the projects teach life and work skills.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. The page calls the program new and gives no dates.

name: Teen Advisory Board (TAB)
what_you_do: Teens meet twice a month to brainstorm ideas, plan programs and help improve the library for teens.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-2027 were due September 1, 2026. Next year's date is not posted yet.

name: Wonder Guides
what_you_do: Wonder Guides help visitors and staff at a children's museum. You learn how the museum runs. Other volunteer jobs are play help and special events.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: Museum Teen Council
what_you_do: Make art, talk about art, and learn from people who work in the art world. Council members also take part in volunteer chances and community events.
deadline_text: The Fall 2026 group started October 7, 2026 (applications were due September 16). Spring 2027 applications open December 1 and are due January 20.

name: Yellowstone County 4-H
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club and do projects in things like animals, shooting sports and other skills. Clubs are run by adult leaders.
deadline_text: The 4-H year starts October 1. Clubs may take new members until December 1 or until they are full. The page does not state the year; the club list is labeled 26-27.

name: Yellowstone County Summer Jobs Program
what_you_do: Get a paid summer job with a local employer. You also do a paid work skills training before summer and get an adult mentor.
deadline_text: No current dates on the program page. The article is from August 2024.

name: Bismarck Parks and Recreation District Part-Time Jobs for Ages 14 and 15+
what_you_do: Part-time jobs. Open to 14 year olds. Youth basketball official, ice arena attendant, open gym supervisor and youth tennis instructor. Open to 15 year olds. Lifeguard, swim lesson instructor, after-school BLAST leader and youth basketball coach.
deadline_text: No application deadline is listed for part-time or seasonal jobs.

name: Zoo Crew Teen Volunteers at Blank Park Zoo
what_you_do: Teens volunteer in education and guest services. They help Safari camp counselors, give directions, keep the zoo clean and help at family events. First-year teens do not work directly with animals.
deadline_text: Applications for 2027 are accepted January 1, 2027 to March 1, 2027.

name: Volunteer Program (Discovery Center of Idaho)
what_you_do: Talk with visitors on the museum floor. Help at camps during school breaks. Tell people about the Discovery Center at community events. Group projects include packing and building supplies.
deadline_text: The application window is open through November 30, 2026.

name: Idaho Humane Society Student Service and Teen Volunteering
what_you_do: Tour the animal shelter, learn how it works, and help with jobs like dishes, laundry, yard work and washing windows. Students 14 and older can later become long-term volunteers.
deadline_text: No deadline. Register for each session you want to attend. Session dates are not stated on the program page.

name: Youth Employment Services (Idaho Department of Labor)
what_you_do: Get free help finding work and finishing school. Services can include paid and unpaid work experience, job training, tutoring, and a mentor.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Services are offered through local Idaho Department of Labor offices.

name: YouthWorks! (Idaho Youth Ranch)
what_you_do: Work part time at a real work site for 8 weeks and learn job skills. High school students are especially encouraged to apply.
deadline_text: Treasure Valley applications are not being accepted right now because of a long wait list. A reopening date is not stated on the program page.

name: Outdoor Pool Lifeguards and Summer Pool Jobs
org: City of Boise Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Take a city lifeguard course. Then work at one of four outdoor pools. They are Borah, Fairmont, Ivywild and the Natatorium.
deadline_text: Class information for the 2027 season will be updated and available for registration in early December (the year is not stated on the program page). The page said job postings for Summer 2026 were open; check the city job postings for current openings.

grades: Incoming juniors and seniors (2027-28 school year)
name: Health Sciences Camp
org: Boise State University College of Health Sciences
what_you_do: A 3-day camp for students who like health sciences. You stay two nights in a campus dorm.
deadline_text: Registration opens in January 2027 (no day given). Join the waitlist on the camp page for alerts.

name: STEM Gems Summer Camp
org: Boise State University College of Engineering
what_you_do: Go to a free overnight STEM camp at Boise State. Try workshops in engineering and science topics and see what college is like.
deadline_text: Applications for summer 2026 are closed. They reopen in early 2027. A closing date is not posted.

name: Watershed Action Team (Boise WaterShed)
what_you_do: Help build and run water and climate lessons at the Boise WaterShed. You also work at WaterShed events and community STEM nights.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026 are closed. The program page says applications are typically open in March for the following summer.

name: Cedar Rapids Parks and Recreation Seasonal Jobs (Lifeguard, Day Camp, Parks)
org: City of Cedar Rapids Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Seasonal city jobs. Roles include lifeguard, swim instructor and pool cashier or concessions. Others are day camp counselor, youth sports staff, Old MacDonald's Farm staff, park grounds crew and golf course help.
deadline_text: The seasonal program page lists job fairs on Jan 30 and Feb 6 (no year shown), and says applications are taken online during the hiring season. The 2027 posting is not up yet.

name: Summer STEM Bridge
what_you_do: Take two college classes in person over eight weeks. One class is network security. The other is a math class. You also go on two field trips to Idaho National Laboratory and build a portfolio.
grades: High school sophomore, junior or senior in the 2026/2027 school year, or a 2026 graduate
deadline_text: The 2026 program ran June 2 to July 23, 2026. Registration was completed by May. The program page does not mention a 2027 session.

name: CHI St. Alexius Health Teen Volunteers (Bismarck)
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the hospital. They do not provide hands-on patient care.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.

name: Zoo Crew Teen Volunteers at Dakota Zoo
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the zoo. Roles are Camp Mentor, Conservation Educator and Junior Zookeeper Mentor. Off-season they help with Ed-Venture Camps. They also help with Saturdays with Santa, Winter Zookeeper Camp and the Easter Egg Hunt.
deadline_text: No start date or application deadline is listed on the program page.

name: Teen Volunteers at the Animal Rescue League
what_you_do: Volunteer at the Animal Rescue League of Iowa shelter. The program page does not list the exact jobs.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Fill out the volunteer application.

name: Des Moines Art Center Teen Arts Academy and Teen Clay Academy
what_you_do: A nine month art program for high school students. Students meet once a week and build a portfolio. You can apply for the Arts Academy, the Clay Academy, or both.
deadline_text: Applications close Thursday, October 15, 2026, and Teen Academy classes begin that day.

name: Volunteers (Greater Des Moines Botanical Garden)
what_you_do: Volunteer in education, guest services, plant care (horticulture) or office help. There is a short form for event volunteers. Events include the Spring Garden Festival and Trick or Trees.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Fill out the volunteer application any time.

name: Summer Concurrent Enrollment (DMACC Career Advantage)
what_you_do: Take a real college class in the summer. Earn college credit while you are still in high school. Summer 2026 classes included anatomy and physiology, statistics, programming, medical terms and accounting.
grades: Current juniors and younger (rising seniors and below)
deadline_text: The 2026 pre-registration form is closed. The program page lists no deadline for future summers.

name: BullD.O.G.S. in Healthcare Summer Camp (Drake University)
org: Drake University College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences
what_you_do: Spend a weekend on the Drake campus and try out health jobs. Join sessions on nursing, occupational therapy and pharmacy. Do hands-on labs. Visit a local health group.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran July 9 to 11, 2026. Registration closed June 1, 2026 at noon. 2027 dates: not stated on the program page.

name: Youth and Young Adult Services (IowaWORKS, WIOA Youth)
what_you_do: Get free help from a career planner. Services can include summer and year-round jobs, internships, job shadowing, tutoring, job training and a mentor. You must qualify first.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Services are offered all year through local IowaWORKS offices.

name: Day Camp Junior Counselor
what_you_do: Help staff counselors run summer day camp on a 500 acre living history farm. You lead games and songs, help with crafts, set up and clean up, and are a role model for campers.
deadline_text: The program page still shows 2026 dates: group interviews on March 26, April 7 and April 11, and training on April 18. The volunteer page says applications will reopen in early 2027. Exact dates are not posted yet.

name: Des Moines Parks and Recreation Lifeguard Class and Seasonal Jobs
org: City of Des Moines Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Take the American Red Cross lifeguard class. Then apply for lifeguard jobs at city pools. One is the Prairie Meadows Pool at Reichardt Community Recreation Center.
deadline_text: Lifeguard job applications are open now with no closing date posted. The next lifeguard class on the page is Dec 4 to 6, with limited spots.

name: Volunteer Pre-Intern Program (Des Moines Playhouse)
what_you_do: Help teach theatre classes as a student assistant, or work backstage on shows. Backstage jobs include light or sound board, spotlight, assistant stage manager and work crew. Training is provided.
deadline_text: No deadline is stated on the program page. Fall, Winter and Spring 2026-27 opportunities are listed on the page.

name: Summer Camp Sidekick Volunteer (Polk County Conservation)
what_you_do: Help naturalists run nature camps for kids ages 6 to 11 at Jester Park. You help with games, crafts and outdoor activities. Training is provided and no experience is needed.
deadline_text: For 2026 the application deadline was May 1. 2027 dates: not stated on the program page.

name: Youth Corps Crew Member (Polk County Conservation)
what_you_do: Work on a crew of teens in county parks. You remove invasive plants, maintain trails, and plant seedlings. You also learn about the environment and try outdoor recreation. The program includes at least one overnight camping trip.
deadline_text: Applications are closed for Fall 2026. The program page said 2026 summer sessions ran June 8 to 26 and July 13 to 31. 2027 dates: not stated on the program page.

name: Des Moines Public Library VolunTeens
what_you_do: Help the Youth Services Librarians at your local branch. Teens help at kids' events and sign kids and teens up for Summer Reading. They also prepare crafts for storytimes and make displays.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.

name: Y-ExCL Summer Program (Evelyn K. Davis Center)
org: Lutheran Services in Iowa, Evelyn K. Davis Center for Working Families
what_you_do: Train for 2 weeks on work skills, then work 8 weeks at a job placement. You work Monday through Thursday.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2026 are closed. The program page says to check back in Spring 2027. The schedule on the page: training June 2 to 13, then job placement June 16 to August 7 (the page does not give the year).

name: Northwest Youth Corps Youth Camping Crews
what_you_do: Teens camp for the whole session. They plant trees, thin brush, pull invasive plants, build trails and put up fences on public land in the Northwest.
deadline_text: 2026 dates are posted. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Fargo Park District Lifeguard Jobs
what_you_do: Work as a lifeguard at the district's pools. Shifts are on weekdays and some weekends over the summer. You need a current American Red Cross lifeguard certificate.
deadline_text: No application deadline is posted on the program page.

name: Fargo Public Library Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help behind the scenes at the library. Teens shelve books, decorate the teen area and prepare craft supplies. Tasks change by session.
deadline_text: Register for each session. Upcoming dates on the page: Nov 7, Dec 5, Jan 2, Feb 6, Mar 6, Apr 3 and May 1. Locations switch between the Main Library and the Dr. James Carlson Library.

name: Montana Cybersecurity Summer Initiative (CSI) Camp
what_you_do: A day camp for Montana students. It lasts a week. You learn about cybersecurity.
deadline_text: 2026 camp was June 15 to 19. 2027 dates are not posted on the program page.

name: Grand Forks Park District Part-Time Winter Jobs (Community Center, Warming House)
what_you_do: Two part-time jobs posted now. At First Seasons Community Center you run the cash register and concessions, help customers and do light cleaning. As a warming house attendant you watch the outdoor skating rink building and enforce rink rules.
deadline_text: The employment page shows Oct 1, 2026 next to both postings. It does not say if that is a closing date.

name: Nebraska State Fair Seasonal Job: Cleaning Squad
what_you_do: Keep the fairgrounds tidy during the Nebraska State Fair. You are on your feet for hours and work on your own. This is the one 2026 fair job on the flyer open to age 16.
deadline_text: 2026 shifts were August 28 to September 7, 2026. 2027 hiring not posted yet on the program page.

name: Lifeguard training and city pool jobs
org: City of Great Falls Park and Recreation
what_you_do: Get your American Red Cross lifeguard card. Then watch swimmers and handle emergencies at city pools. The city says lifeguards also learn CPR, AED and first aid.
deadline_text: Lifeguard openings are posted online when they are available. No dates are posted.

name: Teen Art Program (TAP)
org: Paris Gibson Square Museum of Art
what_you_do: Make art with other teens in a group at the museum. Food and art supplies are provided.
deadline_text: As of an April 2, 2026 update, the program is on a temporary break until the museum finds an instructor.

name: Library volunteer program
what_you_do: Shelve and clean books. Help with youth and summer reading programs. Put craft kits together. Or help keep the building and grounds neat.
deadline_text: Not stated.

name: Great Plains Zoo Junior Zookeeper (JZK)
what_you_do: Teens volunteer all summer at the zoo. First-year jobs are helping at ZooCamp or greeting guests and running story time. Returning teens can care for farm animals and present animals.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed March 6 (returning teens) and March 27 (new teens). 2027 dates are not posted. Email Education@GPZoo.org to be told when applications open.

name: Cancer Research High School Program
org: Huntsman Cancer Institute, University of Utah, with the American Cancer Society
what_you_do: A two week virtual program with lab lessons using a science kit sent to your home. You receive up to $500 in financial compensation.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran February 10 to April 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: HCI-RISE: Remote Immersive Science Experience
org: Huntsman Cancer Institute, University of Utah
what_you_do: A virtual two week summer program on cancer research and health careers, with workshops, career panels and small group work. You are paid up to $400.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran February 10 to April 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Know Your Government (KYG) Conference
org: University of Idaho Extension 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: A weekend conference in Boise. It is about how state government works. It is for 4-H youth in the Know Your Government project.
deadline_text: 2027 conference is February 13 to 15. Registration opens in December (day not stated).

name: Idaho 4-H State Teen Association Convention (STAC)
what_you_do: Spend four days on a college campus. Go to workshops, tour the campus and community, do a service project, and meet teens from across Idaho. You also explore careers and college.
grades: Youth who have completed 8th through 12th grade
deadline_text: The 2026 event was June 22 to 25, 2026. The last price window ended May 31. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Junior Zoo Crew
org: Idaho Falls Zoo at Tautphaus Park (City of Idaho Falls)
what_you_do: Join a 3-week zoo session, three days a week, from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. in the zoo's Junior Zoo Crew program.
deadline_text: Applications are closed for 2026. The page says applications open February 1st. In 2026 they closed April 18 at 4:00 p.m.

name: The Idaho Foodbank Volunteer Shifts
what_you_do: Sort donated food, repack bulk food into family size bags, label cans and build backpack food inserts. Shifts are in a warehouse.
deadline_text: No deadline. Book a shift any time.

name: Natural Resources Camp (University of Idaho Extension)
what_you_do: Spend a week at camp learning about wildlife, forestry, soils, rangeland and water. Do hands-on labs and talks with natural resource workers. Also hike, fish, shoot archery and compete in camp contests.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran June 15 to 20, 2026. The $310 fee was due by May 20. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Idaho Science and Aerospace Scholars (ISAS)
what_you_do: Take an online course made by NASA about space travel. It has eight units and a project. Top students may be invited to a week at the University of Idaho. There you plan a pretend mission to Mars with mentors.
deadline_text: The 2026-2027 application is open. A closing date is not stated on the program page.

name: GEM High School Internship
org: Idaho State Museum (Idaho State Historical Society)
what_you_do: Teens meet with museum staff on Tuesday evenings. They sign up for at least 3 volunteer shifts during the program.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026 to 2027 were due September 23 and group interviews were October 6 to 8. Dates for the next round are not posted.

name: iJAG (Iowa Jobs for America's Graduates) School Career Class
what_you_do: A class at some Iowa schools. Students do projects with employers, go to career fairs and the Career Development Conference, and get mentors and work-based learning.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Sign up through your school.

name: K-12 STEM Future Corps (INL high school internship)
what_you_do: Work six weeks at Idaho National Laboratory. Start with a week of orientation and job skills. Then rotate through facilities doing hands-on work like machining, welding, drafting and heavy equipment. End with a project and a talk.
deadline_text: Application dates are not posted. The fact sheet is dated January 2025 and says the program intends to run from mid June to early August.

name: Iowa 4-H Agricultural Ambassadors
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Teens mentor younger 4-H members and join career panels and tours of farm businesses. They learn to speak up for farming. They also lead a workshop for the whole state.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed July 7. The page does not name the year of that deadline; its schedule starts August 21, 2026. The page does not say when the next application opens.

name: Iowa 4-H Career Pathways Academy
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Teens look at jobs in farming, teaching, business, health, science and skilled trades. They visit colleges and work sites. They shadow local workers.
deadline_text: Dates and deadlines are not stated on the page.

name: Iowa 4-H Reporters
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Teens report on county, regional and state 4-H events from June to August.
deadline_text: Members can apply in January and winners are announced in April (2026 dates not stated on the page). Events run June to August.

name: Iowa State 4-H Council
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Iowa 4-H members in grades 10 and 11 help plan the Iowa 4-H Youth Conference in Ames. They go to five weekend retreats in central Iowa. They also speak for 4-H with county councils and 4-H groups.
deadline_text: Applications open in January and winners are announced in April (2026 dates not stated on the page). No more than 60 interviews are held.

name: Iowa State Fair 4-H Volunteer, Youth Staff and Intern Jobs
org: Iowa 4-H, Iowa State University Extension and Outreach
what_you_do: Iowa only. 4-H members and alumni help run the 4-H Exhibits Building at the Iowa State Fair. They also help with speaking events and livestock and plant shows. They can work as volunteers, paid youth staff or summer interns.
deadline_text: 2026 volunteer form closed July 27. Summer 2027 intern positions open in December 2026. The page does not give 2027 fair dates.

name: Iowa 4-H
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Teens join county clubs and projects. Then they can join state programs such as State 4-H Council, State 4-H Recognition Day, State Project Area Awards and Youth Conference.
deadline_text: Join through 4-H Online. The page does not give a join date. State programs have their own application dates.

name: American Legion Boys State of Iowa
city: Statewide, IA (held at Camp Dodge, Johnston)
what_you_do: Spend six days at Camp Dodge learning how government works. Delegates take part in hands-on government work and leadership events.
deadline_text: Delegate registration opens in January 2027 and closes May 1, 2027. The program runs June 20 to 25, 2027. Post reservations open in October 2026.

name: Heartland Junior Science and Humanities Symposium (Heartland-JSHS)
city: Iowa City, IA (Iowa and Nebraska students)
what_you_do: Do your own research project. Write a paper about it. If it is picked, present it to judges and compete for scholarships.
deadline_text: The paper site opens in October 2026. Papers are due January 11, 2027 (11:59 PM Central). You hear back January 25, 2027. Registration is due February 8, 2027.

name: Iowa Young Writers' Studio Summer Residential Program
org: University of Iowa, Iowa Young Writers' Studio
what_you_do: Spend two weeks on campus studying one kind of writing, such as poetry, fiction, playwriting or TV writing. You learn from students and graduates of the Iowa Writers' Workshop.
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 25, 2027 and close Feb 7, 2027 (11:59 PM Central). Summer 2027 sessions are June 13 to 26 and July 11 to 24.

name: University of Iowa Secondary Student Training Program (SSTP), Summer 2027
what_you_do: Join a University of Iowa faculty member's research group. Work on a research project. If you finish, you earn 3 semester hours of college credit.
deadline_text: Opens Dec 15, 2026 at 5:00 pm CST. Closes Feb 16, 2027 at 11:59 pm CST. Session June 16 to July 23, 2027.

name: Iowa FFA
what_you_do: Iowa only. Students in farm and food classes build leadership and job skills. They do contests, work projects, conferences and the state convention.
deadline_text: The page does not state join dates. Dates for the state convention and officer selection are not on the home page.

name: Pre-Employment Transition Services (Pre-ETS)
org: Iowa Vocational Rehabilitation Services, Iowa Workforce Development
what_you_do: Students with disabilities explore careers, build work skills and try real work. You also get help planning for college or job training. You learn to speak up for yourself.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. You can start working with the program once you turn 14.

name: Job Service North Dakota Youth Employment and Training Program (WIOA Youth)
city: Statewide (offices in Fargo, Bismarck, Grand Forks and more), ND
what_you_do: A case manager builds a plan with you. Help can include a tutor, GED or school help, job shadowing and career exploring. You may also get a mentor and a paid short-term work experience at a public, nonprofit or private business.
deadline_text: No deadline stated in the handbook and brochure.

name: Johnson County Library Teen Volunteers
city: Overland Park and Johnson County, KS
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at library branches and events. This includes summer teen volunteer jobs and teen book reviewing. You sign up for one-time, short-term or weekly spots in an online volunteer portal.
deadline_text: Sign up any time in the volunteer portal. Summer teen opportunities are posted in late April.

name: Kansas 4-H Discovery Days
org: Kansas 4-H Youth Development, Kansas State University
what_you_do: Spend a few days on the K-State campus like a mini college experience. You pick classes, go on tours and meet teens from across Kansas. You build leadership skills.
deadline_text: 2026 event was June 3 to 5. The program page says registration is closed and does not list 2027 dates.

name: VolunTeen Student Summer Volunteer Program
org: The University of Kansas Health System
what_you_do: Volunteer for two weeks in a hospital. You see patient care areas and behind-the-scenes jobs and meet people who work there.
deadline_text: The 2026 application deadline was March 6, 2026. The program page does not list 2027 dates.

name: Leaders in Training and Counselors in Training
what_you_do: Spend five nights at a Kansas 4-H camp ranch in a teen leadership program. Leaders in Training (LIT) is for younger teens. Counselors in Training (CIT) is for older teens.
deadline_text: 2026 sessions ran June 7 to 12, June 14 to 19, July 5 to 10 and July 12 to 17. The program page does not list 2027 dates or a deadline.

name: Health Science Explorers Academy
org: University of Nebraska at Kearney Health Sciences
what_you_do: A year-long program with monthly days on the UNK campus (8:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.): hands-on activities, simulations, guest speakers, field trips and health science lessons from UNK and UNMC faculty.
deadline_text: Registration for the 2027-2028 school year opens January 4, 2027. Close date not stated.

name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital. You get experience in a real health care workplace.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Applications may be kept on file up to six months if there is no opening yet.

name: Library Volunteer Program (teens welcome from age 12)
what_you_do: Help organize materials. Help at youth, teen and adult events and special events. Other tasks are the Book Sale Room, genealogy projects and office work. Training is provided.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page.

name: KU Design Camp
org: University of Kansas School of Architecture & Design
what_you_do: A week on the KU campus. You do design workshops in the morning and afternoon, such as VR and AI design, Minecraft city planning and animation. KU faculty teach them. You live in a residence hall.
deadline_text: 2026 camp ran May 31 to June 6, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted on the program page.

name: KU Engineering Summer Camp
org: University of Kansas School of Engineering
what_you_do: A week-long overnight camp at the KU School of Engineering. Campers use engineering facilities and meet faculty. They live on campus in a residence hall.
grades: Rising 9th and 10th graders, or rising 11th and 12th graders
deadline_text: Registration opens in February 2027 (exact day not stated). The 2027 theme will be announced soon.

name: VolunTeens (grades 7 to 12)
what_you_do: VolunTeens shelve books in a one-hour weekly shift for a semester, or help with youth summer reading programs in the summer. You learn job skills at your favorite library.
deadline_text: The fall semester VolunTeen application is closed. The page says to check back in December for the spring semester application.

name: Zoo Crew (youth volunteers)
what_you_do: Youth volunteers learn from zoo staff, do beginner animal care or help with summer campers, and develop life and job skills. Pick the animal care track or the education track.
deadline_text: Applications open Monday, Nov 2, 2026 at 10 AM and close Friday, Feb 5, 2027 at 5 PM.

name: Lincoln City Libraries Teen Volunteer (VolunTEEN and Teen Advisory Board)
what_you_do: Teens sort and shelve materials. They pull materials for displays, help with bulletin boards and prepare supplies for the Summer Reading Challenge. They also help at special library events. Teens can give input on library collections, spaces and events.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page says to ask the branch if it is taking new volunteers.

name: Mayor's Youth Employment Program
what_you_do: Work a paid summer job with a City of Lincoln department. You also join weekly workshops.
deadline_text: The 2026 application deadline was April 3, 2026 and the enrollment deadline was May 8. The program page does not list 2027 dates.

name: Big Red Summer Academic Camps
org: Nebraska Extension 4-H and University of Nebraska-Lincoln
what_you_do: Week-long camps at UNL where you live on campus. Topics include animation, digital media and engineering. You work with university faculty. You show what you did at a capstone presentation.
deadline_text: Pre-registration and priority scholarship application opens Dec 18 and closes Jan 22. Registration opens Feb 8 at 8:00 a.m. CT. Final registration deadline May 21. The page lists these dates for Big Red Camps 2027.

name: NCMN STEM High School Internship
org: Nebraska Center for Materials and Nanoscience, University of Nebraska-Lincoln
what_you_do: Work in a UNL research lab for about 8 weeks. You give a final poster presentation in August.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were due March 15, 2026. The program page does not list 2027 dates.

name: Innovate: The Raikes School Way Summer Camp
what_you_do: Spend two weeks on campus learning the basics of computer programming. The camp is for high school students interested in computing.
deadline_text: 2026 priority deadline was April 1 and the final deadline was May 1, 2026. The program page does not list 2027 dates.

name: Animal Sciences Leadership Academy
org: K-State Department of Animal Sciences and Industry
what_you_do: Spend four days at K-State learning about livestock and careers. You do workshops and tours, meet professors and industry leaders, and give a team talk.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were due April 30, 2026. The program page does not list 2027 dates.

name: Feeding Your Future Summer Camp
what_you_do: Learn how grain becomes flour and baked goods. You tour K-State feed and flour mills, bake labs and agronomy research farms. Industry partners share job options.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran June 9 to 13. The program page does not list a deadline or 2027 dates.

name: Health Professions Exploration Program
org: Kansas State University College of Health and Human Sciences
what_you_do: A week on the K-State campus. You meet health care professionals, faculty and students and try hands-on activities. You also learn how to apply to professional school. You live in the residence halls.
deadline_text: 2027 dates are listed as June 2027. Application dates are not posted; join the 2027 interest list on the page to get updates.

name: Summer Design Experience
org: K-State College of Architecture, Planning and Design
what_you_do: Try architecture, industrial design and interior architecture. You visit studio labs and meet K-State design professors. You finish a final project. You stay in a campus dorm.
deadline_text: 2026 registration closed on Friday, May 29, 2026. The program page does not list 2027 dates.

name: Summer Fashion Institute
org: Kansas State University College of Health and Human Sciences
what_you_do: High school students try fashion design, illustration and sewing, and bring their own designs to life in a short K-State camp. No sewing experience needed.
deadline_text: Camp is June 7 to 10, 2027. Registration dates are not posted; join the 2027 interest list.

name: VetMed Rocks Summer Camps
what_you_do: Spend a full day in labs with vet students, teachers and teaching animals. You try hands-on tasks and hear about vet careers.
deadline_text: Registration for the 2026 camp is closed. The program page does not list 2027 dates.

name: MercyOne Des Moines Teen Volunteers (Ages 16 to 17)
what_you_do: Volunteer at MercyOne in a role that fits your skills. The program page does not list the teen roles.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.

name: Teen Volunteers (Meridian Library District)
what_you_do: Help the library with holds, events and the summer reading program. Teens fill out a volunteer form on the library's volunteer system.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The library lists volunteer opportunities all year on its volunteer system.

name: Teen Art Project (TAP)
what_you_do: Work with visiting artists to make art. In the Fall 2026 project, teens help make a large textile artwork with artist Amanda Browder for four weeks. Then they work with a new artist and art style each week for four more weeks.
deadline_text: The page says applications for Summer TAP 2027 will open in spring 2027. No deadline is posted.

name: Volunteer with the Montana Natural History Center
what_you_do: Help staff naturalists with kids' games, school field trips and summer camps. Or garden at Fort Missoula. Or greet visitors at the front desk.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: Lifeguard and Summer Jobs at Splash Montana and Currents
org: City of Missoula Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Take the American Red Cross lifeguard course. Then work at Splash Montana or the Currents Aquatics Center. Other summer jobs there do not need you to be certified.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page says summer jobs will be posted soon on the City of Missoula jobs portal.

name: Teen Library Community (TLC)
what_you_do: Help decide what the library offers to teens. Look at the books and suggest buys. Plan teen events. Volunteer at library events. You speak for teens to the Library Board.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: Summer History Institute for High School Students
what_you_do: Spend one week on campus studying U.S. constitutional history. You read old sources, hear guest speakers, take walking tours and visit libraries and archives.
deadline_text: Not offered in 2026. The page says it returns in summer 2027 with details expected in January 2027. In 2025, applications were due June 6.

name: TRIO Upward Bound Summer Academy
what_you_do: Spend six weeks in a free college prep program that feels like college. Students take classes that help with their high school courses. Juniors and seniors can take a 2-credit course.
deadline_text: The page says students must be accepted by May 21, 2027 for the 2027 Academy. The page title still says Summer Academy 2026.

name: Montana 4-H Congress
what_you_do: Spend four days on the Montana State University campus. Go to hands-on workshops and join contests (optional). Meet new people and build leadership skills. Teens can also apply to be state ambassador officers.
deadline_text: The next Congress is July 14 to 17, 2027. Registration opens May 1. The state registration deadline is June 15. Ambassador officer applications are also due June 15.

name: Montana 4-H County Ambassador and State Ambassador Officer
city: Statewide, Montana (county offices; state team based in Bozeman)
what_you_do: Serve as a 4-H county ambassador. Ambassadors who have shown leadership in their county can apply for a state officer role.
deadline_text: County ambassador: apply through your county 4-H (dates set by each county). State officer applications are due, postmarked, by June 15.

name: Montana 4-H Fall Leadership Training
what_you_do: Spend a weekend with other 4-H teen leaders and ambassadors. Go to workshops on Saturday. Hear an alumni speaker at a banquet. Join the statewide ambassador meeting.
deadline_text: Event is November 6 to 8, 2026 at the Copper King Hotel and Convention Center in Butte. State registration closes October 19, 2026.

name: Montana 4-H Foundation Youth Representative
what_you_do: Serve as a youth member of the Montana 4-H Foundation board of trustees. The Foundation raises private funds for the 4-H program.
deadline_text: Send the application before November 1. The page does not name the year, so check the date with the 4-H Foundation.

name: National Park Service Expeditions (Youth Program)
city: Bozeman and Kalispell, MT (Yellowstone and Glacier)
what_you_do: Montana teens join a 9-day camping crew in Glacier or Yellowstone National Park. They do hands-on conservation projects.
deadline_text: Applications are closed for 2026. 2027 youth program applications typically open in February. The page does not state a 2027 deadline.

name: Youth Corps (Helena, Missoula, Flathead)
what_you_do: Montana teens ages 17 to 18 work on conservation projects with a crew. The job lasts a full summer of about 8 weeks.
deadline_text: Applications are closed for 2026. 2027 youth program applications typically open in February. The page says 2026 interviews began early April.

name: Montana Tech Materials Science and Engineering Summer Program
what_you_do: Spend a week on the Montana Tech campus. Do hands-on tasks, go on field trips and visit local industry sites. Hear experts talk about metals and materials.
grades: Rising high school juniors and seniors
deadline_text: The 2026 program ran June 21 to 26, 2026. The application closed March 31, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Monument Health VolunTEEN Program
what_you_do: Teens first do a job shadow at the hospital, then volunteer one shift a week for 10 to 12 weeks. Tasks are not listed on the program page.
deadline_text: Sessions start in October, February and June. Applications are due by the last business day of the month before a session starts, so the February 2027 session needs an application by the end of January 2027.

name: Library Volunteers, ages 13 and up (Nampa Public Library)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the Nampa Public Library on a schedule you set with a manager. Volunteers help staff but do not replace them. At least two staff members must be present when volunteers under 18 are there.
deadline_text: The volunteer page says the library is not currently accepting volunteers. A reopening date is not stated.

name: Young Nebraska Scientists: High School Researchers
what_you_do: Paid summer jobs in the labs of Nebraska scientists, such as quantum materials, nanoscience and chemistry. You learn skills like coding and share your work on a research poster at the end.
grades: 10th or 11th grade in the year you apply
deadline_text: The page says applications are taken in early spring and winners are told usually in April. Exact 2027 dates are not posted on the program page.

name: North Dakota 4-H Ambassador Program
what_you_do: Chosen young leaders for North Dakota 4-H. Ambassadors help plan statewide 4-H events, such as the Extension Youth Conference and retreats. They promote 4-H statewide. They also help at the State Fair and at state or county 4-H events.
deadline_text: Applications are due October 15 for the fall selection, held the Saturday before Thanksgiving at the ND 4-H Camp in Washburn. Elections also happen at the Extension Youth Conference in June, with applications due May 15. The page shows 2026 dates for June.

name: North Dakota Extension Youth Conference (EYC)
what_you_do: A 4 day summer conference at NDSU in Fargo. You build leadership skills and pick workshops.
deadline_text: 2026: early-bird registration ran from Thanksgiving through December, and registration closed June 1. 2027 dates are not posted on the program page.

name: North Dakota 4-H Leadership Awareness Weekend (LAW)
what_you_do: A weekend in Bismarck. Teens learn how local and state government work and how to help their towns.
deadline_text: Event Feb 14 to 15, 2027 in Bismarck. The registration deadline is not listed on the program page.

name: North Dakota Governor's School
org: NDSU Office of Teaching and Learning and University of North Dakota
city: Fargo or Grand Forks, ND (host switches between NDSU and UND)
what_you_do: A four week summer program. You live and study on the NDSU campus. Students rank their top two pathways from Engineering, Information Technology, Laboratory Science or Mathematics. The NDSU page lists dates of June 8 to July 2, 2026 for NDGS 2026.
deadline_text: The NDSU page shows the NDGS 2026 timeline with no year on the later dates: portal opened October 13, 2025 and closed February 15, 2026; acceptance emails March 12 (year not shown); accept by April 10 (year not shown). The 2026 program ran June 8 to July 2. The next session's dates are not posted on the program pages.

name: Oak Futures Youth Employment Program
what_you_do: Paid part-time work at local groups and businesses. There is a nine-week summer job at 20 to 30 hours a week and a year-round job. Some spots are a one-week job shadow or an eight-week internship.
deadline_text: The page says: 'Applications for Summer 2027 will open in the Spring.' No dates posted.

name: Teen Connection Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teens volunteer in the children's hospital. They help kids and families waiting for procedures. They also staff the gift shop, work the information desk or help at special events.
deadline_text: Application form is on the site now. No deadline stated. The hospital says the most need is Monday through Friday in business hours, with few evening or weekend spots.

name: Haddix STEM Corridor Program
org: Creighton University College of Arts and Sciences
what_you_do: Do paid summer research projects for eight weeks at Creighton. You present your work at a poster session.
deadline_text: The Summer 2026 application is closed. The program page does not post next year's dates.

name: Douglas-Sarpy 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club and pick projects to learn by doing. A new club needs one trained adult volunteer and five youth from three different families.
deadline_text: Join any time. To show projects at the Sarpy County Fair or the Nebraska State Fair, enroll by June 15.

name: The Durham Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteers greet guests. They work the admissions desk or museum shop. Or they lead daily activities in exhibits like the log cabin and one-room schoolhouse.
deadline_text: The page lists no deadline. Fill out the Volunteer Interest Form to start.

name: Jr Crew (grades 7 and 8 volunteers)
what_you_do: Junior high students can volunteer at the zoo. The page does not list the exact tasks, so read it for details.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 Jr Crew season open on January 5, 2027. Close date not stated.

name: Kent Bellows Mentoring Program (KBMP)
what_you_do: High school artists work with professional artist mentors all year. They make their own art, build a portfolio and show their work in exhibitions.
grades: Core program: mostly juniors and seniors. Foundations: freshmen and sophomores.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted year-round. Interviews are in March, and most new mentees start in the summer session.

name: Methodist Volunteen
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital through the Volunteen program. You must commit to at least 1 year of service.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. There may be a waiting list because many teens apply.

name: Nebraska Medicine Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteers greet and guide patients and visitors. They help hospital departments. The work is office projects and errands. In some specialty care areas they offer comfort and company to patients.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Apply online any time.

name: Omaha Public Library Volunteer (youth ages 11 to 18)
what_you_do: Volunteers help with library programs and special events. They gain skills like teaching, teamwork and leadership.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted all year.

name: OPS Career Center Pathways
what_you_do: Take hands-on career classes in one of 11 paths. Examples are welding, CNA, EMT, IT or video production. Two paths are off campus: UNMC High School Alliance and Zoo Academy.
deadline_text: The application opens December 1 and closes March 1. Late additions are taken until April 30. The program page does not give a year.

name: Step-Up Omaha
what_you_do: Youth get a paid summer internship. You work for a local employer. Fields include health care, technology, education and construction. You also get job training and learn about careers.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed March 16, 2026 (extended from an earlier date). 2027 dates not posted on the program page.

name: UNMC High School Alliance
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors take hands-on health science classes, like infectious diseases and anatomy. UNMC faculty teach them on the Omaha campus. You also do job shadowing. Classes run Monday to Friday, 1 to 3 pm.
deadline_text: The application page is titled for the 2026-2027 year. An open or close date is not stated on the program pages.

name: Munroe-Meyer Institute Recreational Therapy Volunteer
what_you_do: Students help run recreation programs and Camp Munroe. These are for people with developmental disabilities. They keep activities safe and fun. Training is required.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Contact the volunteer coordinator for current openings.

name: UNO Summer Scholars
org: University of Nebraska Omaha, Student Leadership and Involvement
what_you_do: Take a UNO college course during the summer. The page says tuition, fees, books and parking permits will be covered.
deadline_text: The page does not give an application deadline or 2027 dates. The 2026 session ran May 26 to June 26, 2026.

name: Lifeguard I Outdoor (seasonal)
org: City of Overland Park Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Lifeguards watch swimmers at the city's public pools. They enforce pool safety rules and rescue swimmers in trouble. You must attend required training classes.
grades: Basic education equal to 8th grade for Lifeguard I
deadline_text: Current openings are not shown on the job description page. The job is listed as seasonal.

name: Red River Zoo Wildlife League
what_you_do: Teens volunteer on weekends in zoo departments such as Guest Services, Zookeeping, Grounds and Education. They also work two zoo events each trimester. Examples are Chalkfest, Boo at the Zoo and Lunch with Santa Claus.
deadline_text: The page lists no deadline or trimester dates.

name: Junior Volunteer Program
what_you_do: High school students ages 16 to 18 take part in many volunteer roles. The roles are all around the hospital.
deadline_text: The 2026 window has closed. Applications for the 2027 session will open March 1, 2027. In 2026 all forms were due April 1.

name: Volunteer Program (students 14 and older)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the Nampa hospital. Listed roles include the Cancer Institute and the Gift Shop. Others are Meals on Wheels, the Nampa Health Plaza desk and the Surgery desk.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Sanford Health Sioux Falls Volunteer Program (Ages 16 and Up)
what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital and clinics. Jobs include escort, greeter, gift shop helper and aide. Units include rehab and cardiology. One is the Children's Hospital.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.

name: Science Center of Iowa Junior Camp Counselor and Volunteers
what_you_do: Junior Camp Counselors volunteer with the Science Center's science camps. They are ages 14 to 18. General volunteers are also welcome.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. Summer 2027 applications open in February 2027. No closing date is posted.

name: Sioux Falls Parks and Recreation Lifeguard Training and Aquatics Jobs
org: City of Sioux Falls Parks and Recreation (SFPR Aquatics)
what_you_do: Take the lifeguard class. Then apply to work as a lifeguard at city pools. The class is free if you agree to work for the city.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the program page. The course is listed through the Register for Lifeguard Training link on the page.

name: Siouxland Libraries Teen Volunteer and Teen Advisory Board
what_you_do: Help at a library branch with books, events or keeping it neat. Or join the Teen Advisory Board. It meets once a month to give the library ideas for teens.
deadline_text: Teen Advisory Board applications for 2026-27 ran Aug 11 to Sept 14, 2026. General volunteer forms can be sent any time. If no spot is open, your form stays on file for six months.

name: South Dakota State 4-H Ambassador Program
what_you_do: Teen ambassadors promote 4-H to youth across South Dakota. They follow an action plan. They lead one learning event for youth. They also talk about 4-H with one elected official.
deadline_text: Applications must be submitted by August 1. The page does not give the year, so the next due date is likely August 1, 2027.

name: South Dakota WIOA Title I Youth Program
org: South Dakota Department of Labor and Regulation
what_you_do: Eligible teens meet a state staff member, take an assessment and make an employment plan. The state then gives youth job services. The program page does not list the services.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program pages.

name: Junior Volunteers at St. Luke's
what_you_do: Volunteer at the Boise campus of St. Luke's. The program has orientation, service training, quarterly meetings and monthly service hours.
deadline_text: Applications open the first Monday in November of each year (that is November 2 in 2026). Closing date not stated on the program page.

name: Library Volunteer and Teen Volunteer
org: Topeka and Shawnee County Public Library
what_you_do: Volunteers help at library events. They help with crafts or storytelling for kids. They also do clerical work, help in the Friends Booktique and book sale, and greet visitors. The page also lists a Teen Volunteer path for learning job skills.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The library keeps an application on file for 30 days; apply again if you have not heard back.

name: EcoClub (grades 5 to 12)
what_you_do: EcoClub is for students in grades 5 to 12. The club meets on the 1st and 3rd Tuesday of the month at the zoo.
deadline_text: You may join at any time during the year. The 2026-27 meeting dates are linked on the page.

name: Summer Design Days
org: University of Idaho College of Art and Architecture
what_you_do: Stay on the University of Idaho campus for four days. Take four hands-on workshops. Topics include architecture, art and design, apparel design, interior design and landscape design. Meet design pros and other teens.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran June 24 to 27, 2026. Registration closed June 10, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Mansfield Civics Institute
what_you_do: Live on the University of Montana campus for two weeks. Study the Declaration of Independence, the Constitution and free speech. Do service work. Visit old sites. Build leadership skills.
deadline_text: Applications open November 1, 2026 for the July 5 to 16, 2027 program. A closing date is not posted.

name: UnityPoint Health Iowa Lutheran Hospital Teen Volunteer (Volunteen)
org: UnityPoint Health - Des Moines, Iowa Lutheran Hospital
what_you_do: Teens volunteer in the hospital. Example jobs on the page are in the Emergency Department and gift shop. Others are the Not New Shop, behavioral health tutor and special projects.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.

grades: Students entering their senior year (the 2026 program also allowed 2026 graduates)
name: Schwanke Honors Institute
org: University of Montana Davidson Honors College
what_you_do: Choose one of two college courses with an environment theme. You earn two college credits.
deadline_text: Check back in early 2027 for the 2027 application and dates. 2026 details are shown as an example only.

name: Summer High School Institute (HSI)
what_you_do: A three-week summer program for Wyoming 10th graders. You live on the University of Wyoming campus.
deadline_text: Applications for HSI 2027 opened October 1, 2026. All pieces are due by February 7, 2027.

name: Youth Urban and Community Forestry Crew (Tacoma)
what_you_do: Join a crew of 8 teens and 2 adult leaders on tree and park projects in city parks, public lands and community gardens. About 32 hours a week of work plus 8 hours of training.
deadline_text: 2026 Washington sessions ran June 22 to July 24 and July 28 to Aug 28 (dates subject to change). 2027 dates and deadline not posted.

name: WAM Nights: Past and Present Teen Studio Workshop
what_you_do: Join a free evening studio workshop for teens. The art is inspired by sculptors in the Past and Present show, such as Nick Cave, Dan Friday and Beth Lipman.
deadline_text: Friday, November 6, 2026, 6 to 8 p.m.

name: Exploration Place Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at a science museum. Jobs include ticket services, floor attendant, store and snack bar help, special events and grounds help.
deadline_text: No deadline is stated. Volunteers sign up for shifts on the volunteer calendar.

name: Teens Through Time
what_you_do: Meet monthly with other high school students to learn how a museum works and local history. Together you plan and run a Teen Night at the museum in April.
deadline_text: The sign-up deadline for 2026-2027 was Monday, October 5, 2026. The program page does not give next year's date.

name: Teen Advisory Board and Summer Reading Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teen Advisory Board members meet monthly. They share ideas on teen programs and the teen collection. Summer Reading teen volunteers help families sign up, tidy, shelve, prepare crafts and help at events.
deadline_text: Teen Advisory Board: email the teen librarian to join. The 2026 Summer Reading volunteer applications have ended. No 2027 dates are posted on the program page.

name: Sedgwick County 4-H
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club that meets monthly. Clubs use hands-on learning to build life skills.
deadline_text: Youth can enroll online at any time.

name: Special Event Volunteer (age 14 and up)
what_you_do: Volunteers help run zoo special events like Easter Eggstravaganza, Boo at the Zoo and Zoobilee. You can sign up for all events or only the ones that fit your schedule.
deadline_text: The zoo says it is currently taking special event volunteer applications. Orientation is held twice a month; the last one this year is October 22, 2026, and the next is April 2027.

name: Wesley Medical Center Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteers work an information desk. They escort patients and guests. They help in the emergency department and hospital units. They also support families with comfort care. No direct medical care.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Download, fill out and mail or email the application any time.

name: Engineering Summer Camps
org: Wichita State University College of Engineering
what_you_do: Take a camp on the WSU campus. Most camps last one week. High school options in 2026 were Biomedical Engineering, Ethical Hacking and Capture the Flag, Python, and an electrical circuits day.
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened March 19, 2026. The program page does not list 2027 dates.

name: Upward Bound Math Science
what_you_do: Get help getting ready for college in math, science, engineering or health careers. The summer part is a six-week residential program in June and July.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: Job Prep (free course that leads to a summer job)
what_you_do: A free weekly class teaches job applications, resumes, dressing for work, money skills and mock interviews. You also earn CPR-AED and First Aid certification. Students who pass qualify for a summer job.
deadline_text: Last cycle: Wichita enrollment deadline January 12, 2026. Newton applications were accepted until December 15, 2025. The next dates are not posted on the program page.

name: Youth Employment Project (YEP)
org: Workforce Alliance of South Central Kansas
what_you_do: Free job-skills workshops cover workplace etiquette, customer service, resume and interview skills, and money. You earn a Youth Essential Skills Certificate. Age 16 and up can then be matched to a paid summer work placement.
deadline_text: The FAQ says to register by June 1 or as soon as possible; workshops and job fairs start in March to May. The FAQ page says registration is open, but it does not give a year.

name: Wyoming Game and Fish Youth Camps (Girls Camp and Boys Camp)
what_you_do: A week-long camp. It has hands-on lessons in identifying animals, watersports, science research and archery.
deadline_text: Applications are closed for 2026. The page says applications open January 1, 2027. A closing date is not stated.

name: WIOA Youth Program (Workforce Centers)
city: Statewide (Cheyenne, Casper, Laramie and other Workforce Centers)
what_you_do: You get help finding what you are good at and make a job plan. Then you get work experience or training with local employers.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Contact your local Workforce Center.

name: ZooTeens
what_you_do: Go to a training session with a hands-on animal encounter. Then help zoo education staff run at least one five-day children's summer camp.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. The page gives no year or deadline.
